entities.name: Robert Kubica
entities.description: Finished the next 3 races in the points, including a 4th place in Malaysia, 5th place in Shanghai, and 8th place in Barcelona. Finished in 3rd place in Monaco.

entities.name: Vitaly Petrov
entities.description: Scored his first points in Formula 1 in China with a 7th place finish. Retired in the closing laps of the Monaco race but was still classified 13th.
